Product Description >	
WIRELESS WORKING & BUILT-IN 20000mAh BATTERY:
The 10-inch portable battery operated fan comes with a dual 10000mAh large capacity battery pack, which can power the fan up to 50 hours at the proper setting. When detached from the fan, the rechargeable battery can serve as a mobile resource for your phone.

2 IN 1 DESK AND PEDESTAL FAN:
This versatile fan with a pedestal for portable use can transform into a desk and table fan that you can either place on the bedside table or take to the camping site. And also comes with a tripod to use as a floor fan in your bedroom or office, which provides you more choice to adjust the height and angles, perfect for your home, office, outdoor activities.

AUTO OSCILLATION & STEPLESS SPEED:
It supports 45 - 90°horizontal auto oscillation, that it can be positioned in a way to fit your needs, it’s also fairly adjustable, with stpless speed, which has no specific wind speed setting limit maximizes your comfort, keep you relax with the utmost comfort at each direction.

REMOTE CONTROL & TIMING OFF:
Smart button control combined with remote control, you can control the fan from afar-even bed, but within 20ft, turn the fan off, lower the speed, oscillation, timing off, etc. And the advanced fan also comes with a timer (1-2-4-8H) function."
